In Public Sector & Government, cloud, edge & platform engineering builds the runtime for everything else we do: hybrid and multicloud architecture, cloud-native modernization of legacy estates, edge and distributed infrastructure for latency-critical operations, sre and reliability engineering, internal developer platforms, finops, and mission-critical high-performance systems. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: hybrid & multicloud architecture, cloud-native & legacy modernization, edge computing & distributed infrastructure — delivered on Fleet Management System and BI & Analytics Platform with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Legacy mainframes as single points of failure
Tax, benefits and licensing cores run on platforms with shrinking talent pools; failure risk compounds annually.
Benefits, tax, health and licensing systems never joined; citizens re-submit the same facts to every agency. Fraud and error hide in the seams.
Permits, claims and case files are paper-shaped; processing times measured in months erode trust and increase cost per case.

blocks.x: How we deliver it in this sector

The delivery pattern composes 7 services from the Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering tower — Hybrid & Multicloud Architecture, Cloud-Native & Legacy Modernization, Edge Computing & Distributed Infrastructure, SRE & Reliability Engineering as the usual core — sequenced through the Achala Method with sector controls: Procurement law obligations shape the design from the first sprint.
Services we deploy in this sector

items: The estate as designed system — landing zones, network fabric and workload placement by economics.
Retire the legacy tax — strangler-pattern modernization with measurable unit economics.
Compute where the physics is — edge fabric for plants, stores, vehicles and grids.
Reliability as product — SLOs, error budgets and incident discipline that engineers actually follow.
landing zones meeting accreditation with continuous evidence (agencies onboard in weeks)
strangler decomposition with parallel-run equivalence (mainframe risk reduced on schedule)
first-contact resolution up sharply with grounded assistants

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: Procurement law and EU AI Act. public-sector AI uses largely high-risk with conformity duties. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.
